papers.title: YOLOv10
papers.evidence: Table5 on top of light classifier: 9.9M->8.0M, AP44.2->44.4. Table7 compares PW-DW vs DW-PW, not original dense conv. Table9 extra CIB scope eventually reduces AP.

papers.title: RepViT
papers.evidence: Block change alone drops71.5->68.3; narrower FFN with width reallocation recovers73.5. Table6 SR alone gives0.2-0.27 points.

papers.title: InceptionNeXt
papers.evidence: Targets large-kernel DW speed. Removing either band branch lowers82.3->81.9. Not equivalent to old project PW-DW-PW head.

papers.title: FasterNet
papers.evidence: Partial dense3x3 plus full pointwise MLP and residual. Table5 different ratios use modified widths/depths. FasterNet-S detector49.0M vs ResNet50 detector44.2M: speed gain not automatic parameter gain.

papers.title: Rewrite the Stars
papers.evidence: Multiplication strengthens nonlinear interactions in fixed two-branch architecture; not an automatic parameter reduction from one dense conv.

papers.title: GhostNetV3
papers.evidence: Reparameterization and KD/recipe gains on compact backbone; not a new parameter-cutting operator.

judgment: Try a single detection-specific reduction module at original-author deep downsample scope. Existing results do not causally establish that spatial/channel factorization is inherently harmful.
experiment_target: About21% parameter reduction, maintain or improve baseline VOC75.65/COCO56.4; accuracy is a target not a prediction.
validation: real GPU AMP updates and validation/EMA
